pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal to sub-rounded dark regions with soft pixel-level edge gradients. Patch spatial area is smaller on the cervical region and expands into larger, more elongated geometries on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light interstitial pathways. Junctions are primarily tri-radiate nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively thin and consistent, maintaining a closed topological mesh across the visible anatomy.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette visible along the dorsal neck, defined by short hair clusters that create a jagged 1D contour against the background.
